realGroqRuns.request: Create a QWERTY keyboard with a message display, separate rows of letters, Space, Backspace, Clear, and Speak. Tapping letters and Space updates the display. Backspace removes one character. Clear empties it. Speak speaks the current nonempty message only when pressed; typing must not speak.

Create a restaurant communication interface with a message display and two tabs: Food with exactly Bread, Rice, Soup; Drinks with exactly Water, Juice, Milk. Tapping a word adds it and a space to the message without speaking. Switching tabs keeps the message. Add Speak and Clear. Speak says the current nonempty message only when pressed. Clear empties the message and is harmless when repeated.

localComparison.conclusion: Useful for the tested native helper and narrow selected edit. Not sufficient evidence for a reliable general-purpose interface builder: restaurant creation and imported-grid visual request failed. Do not replace Groq or claim deployment acceptance from this experiment.
limitations: Single attempt per task; not a reliability estimate.
Real model responses, not mocked generations. Native speech dispatch was observed with audio API recorded in isolated browsers; audible playback was not independently measured.
Read-only repository source tool was available but unused; final imported-edit retry also received actual Grid/Color source excerpts.
Reported tokens include repeated prompt context; local inference has no Groq quota.
Existing editor progress text says Groq because the local experiment injects only the inference transport; all recorded inference calls went to the local model.
Protocols differ as observed failures were corrected; these runs are not a controlled model ranking.
Ordinary Preview and native roundtrip passes are recorded per attempt; isolated draft-ready status alone does not prove a working interface.
Native speech dispatch was recorded in isolated replay browsers; audible playback was not independently measured.
Local imported-grid visual requests failed despite native draft acceptance; computed-style verification caught unchanged blue buttons.
Remaining real acceptance includes dwell/two-switch access, OSS imported targeted edits, final settings/repeatability and deployed browser verification.
